title: SKE Crystal Menthol Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Menthol flavour from SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid provides a pure and invigorating vaping experience with its intensely cool and refreshing taste. Ideal for those who enjoy the sensation of a crisp, clean menthol hit, this e-liquid brings a blast of frosty freshness that's perfect for cleansing the palate or enjoying as an all-day vape. SKE's Crystal Nic Salts collection ensures a smoother throat hit with its nicotine salt formulation, ideal for ex-smokers and those who prefer a mild nicotine delivery. The 50VG/50PG ratio is optimized for mouth-to-lung devices, delivering a balanced blend of flavour and cloud production. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
